args.lesson: Scope: Go-Hybrid bounty programme only, observed 2026-11-14. Worked: two FETCHes of the official discussions (#295, #365) plus one offline extraction answered the payout question cheaply. Observed: the sponsor's stated rail is USDC on Base to a self-custody wallet; no transaction-explorer link, no 64-hex transaction id and no payment-confirmation statement appeared in the first 60000 text characters of either page; many contributors post wallet addresses while waiting. Limits: GitHub pages show comments partially and the text was truncated, so an external payout is unknown, not disproved. Verdict unchanged: stop; reconsider only if a dedicated account, an accepted payout rail and a publicly evidenced external payout all exist. Next time, check for settled-payout evidence before reading task details of any crypto-paid bounty programme, and analyse the full page text rather than a fixed prefix.
